title: Load a paint roller evenly on a ribbed tray
instruction: Load the paint roller evenly. Roll it through the well and over the ribbed ramp to remove excess paint. Leave it on the tray's flat rest.
context: Roll a mini sleeve through the paint well and over the ribbed ramp to prepare it for use.
setup: A 100 mm roller axle rests at (324, -225, 22) mm with the handle angled up 22 degrees. The tray origin is (345, -47) mm with a 157 mm well, 150 mm ramp and a raised parking pocket. Coordinates are relative to the tabletop. For physical trials use a Cottam PPA00067 frame and an unused dry Cottam PPR00037 100 mm microfibre sleeve. Fill the level well to 8 ± 1 mm with undiluted blue Crayola Artista II Washable Tempera Paint. See the README for the tray build and rig protection.
scoring: 0.20 per band with at least 10 of 12 sectors wetted by rolling contact. Final 0.20 for all bands covered, 69 mm or more of ramp rolling after coating, and 5 s released on the rest. The center and frame must remain within 2 mm and 3 degrees of their pose at the start of that hold. In physical trials, use the README's single-revolution witness grid for band coverage. A cell counts at 3 of 4 coated sample circles. Award the final 0.20 only for four passing bands, 69 mm or more after the last paint pickup, a qualifying 5 s park, and zero new blue spots at least 2 mm across on the 5 s drip card.
reset_notes: Restore the authored pose and joints. Clear trial history and visual state. Use seed 0 and zero object jitter. For the physical trial use a fresh dry sleeve and fresh cards. Clean the tray and rests and refill the level well to 8 ± 1 mm.
fidelity: An independent sleeve joint drives the contact-based coverage estimate. Simulated ramp rolling models removal of excess. Physical trials use a one-revolution witness strip and a timed drip card. The simulation does not model liquid paint, transfer to paper, or free drips.
